name: Tag
summary: A small label chip for a category, keyword, or state — filled or bordered, with an icon, a dismiss ×, or a checkable toggle.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-tag> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens. The DS V3 Tag is a family: a semantic `color` preset (neutral · primary · success · processing · warning · error), a filled (default) or `bordered` outlined shape, an optional leading `icon` (by name from the DS icon library), a `closable` × that animates out then removes + emits a composed `close`, and a `checkable` toggle flavour carrying a selected state (aria-pressed) that emits `change`. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper for the `close`/`change` events; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Box
spec.value: height 22 · radius 4 · padding 0 8 · 6px gap to a 14px leading icon

spec.label: Bordered
spec.value: white surface + a coloured 1px hairline (the outlined DS V3 flavour)

spec.label: Closable
spec.value: system-x ✕; animates out (scale + fade, motion-mid) then removes + emits close

spec.label: Checkable
spec.value: outlined toggle; checked → brand fill #6A1EBB / white label; aria-pressed synced

props.name: color
props.type: neutral | primary | success | processing | warning | error

props.name: bordered
props.desc: Outlined shape — white surface + a coloured 1px hairline instead of the filled tint

props.name: icon
props.desc: Leading DS icon name, e.g. system-tag (resolved via <aha-icon>)

props.name: closable
props.desc: Shows a dismiss × that animates out, removes the tag, and emits close

props.name: checkable
props.desc: Renders a selectable toggle chip (button, aria-pressed)

props.name: checked
props.desc: Selected state of a checkable tag (brand fill)

props.name: close
props.desc: Composed event when the × is pressed

props.name: change
props.desc: Composed event on a checkable toggle, detail { checked }

whenToUse.when: labelling content with a category/keyword, or showing a non-urgent state inline
a count or a status dot attached to another element
the chip should trigger an action — a Tag is a label, not a control

opinion.note: Keep tag text to one or two words, sentence case. Colour carries meaning — reserve success/processing/warning/error for real states, not decoration. Use `closable` for user-removable keywords; use `checkable` for an inline filter toggle. For a domain lifecycle state prefer the status pill (aha-design-status-badges).
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 Tag component sets (`Tag` + `Tag/Outlined`, fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy) and the measured `tag|*` / `tagz|*` reference cells. The measured `tag` cell is an OUTLINED chip (radius 4, 1px border #D3D7E1, rest→hover→active tinting toward color-primary) — captured here as the `bordered` shape. The filled tint flavour (neutral/primary/success/processing/warning/error) is the DS label-chip form derived from the bg/text positive·informative·warning·negative token families. `icon` (leading system glyph), `closable` (system-x ✕ with animate-out + composed close), and `checkable` (the selectable toggle with a brand-fill checked state + aria-pressed + composed change) complete the matrix. Radius from the 4/6/8/12/16 scale (radius-xs). Motion bound to the shared motion tokens on persistent nodes — the checked flip and the close collapse both animate; the checked toggle syncs on the persistent chip (no subtree rebuild). Not-yet-modelled: the five discrete tagz sizes (xs/sm/md/lg/xl) — this element ships the single h22 label size; a `size` axis is the follow-up if product needs it.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. Probe = a primary filled tag with a leading icon + a closable sibling.
